subject: Request for external processor visibility and escalation plan
messages:
From: Mike Sullivan <mike.sullivan@econify.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@econify.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: full subprocessor inventory + routing for US/EU

Hi Aditya,

We're finalizing procurement for our upcoming integration with Redwood and legal needs a complete snapshot of your current third-party processing roster and a map of where EU-originated tenant data may transit or be stored (including any transient processors). Specifically: 

- Full list of subprocessors in the last 30 days (name, country, role).
- Any temporary/transient agents and expected retention windows.
- If you have an onshore fallback for EU-resident data (yes/no + where).

This is gating our SOC2 checklist and procurement sign-off — can you provide an extract we can attach to our DPA review? If you can send the inventory in CSV and a simple diagram showing regional egress paths, that would be ideal.

We appreciate quick turnaround; procurement would like this by EOD Monday, Sep 7.

Thanks,
Mike Sullivan
Head of Security Operations
Econify

[This message arrived without attachments]

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: full subprocessor inventory + routing for US/EU

Team — forwarding Econify's ask. Procurement wants a 30-day snapshot + routing diagram, with an explicit note about onshore fallback. They asked for CSV + diagram by Sep 7 (EOD).

Can Legal/Privacy confirm any outstanding approvals needed before we share the inventory CSV? Naomi, is there a trimmed version we should provide (redact internal IPs/contacts) or do we send full roster? Jordan, any DPA addendum language we should pre-populate?

I'll collate existing inventory and generate the diagram; will attach the draft to this thread.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

[Attachment (to send): draft_subprocessor_inventory_notes.txt]

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: full subprocessor inventory + routing for US/EU

Thanks for the ping. Quick triage: we can provide the 30-day inventory but should withhold infrastructure-only hostnames and internal employee contact details. Provide columns: vendor name, vendor country, role (telemetry, CDN, KMS, observability, analytics, etc.), contractual data access (yes/no), and processing location(s).

Onshore fallback: we have a documented onshore fallback for EU traffic (US-east and EU-west on dedicated gateways) but it depends on customer selection for residency. For Econify, we should state the fallback exists and the default behavior (hosted customers may see transient processing in partner regions unless they select EU residency).

Jordan — please prepare a short DPA addendum template we can attach that says: 1) snapshot provided as of date, 2) redaction applied per Privacy Team, 3) offer a follow-up evidentiary packet under NDA if they need full logs.

I'll prep the CSV with redaction and a simplified dataflow diagram. Aditya/Kim — can you confirm whether Econify is planning EU residency? That will change the wording.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Privacy Counsel
Redwood Inference

[Attachment referenced: privacy_redaction_guidelines.pdf (not included in this reply)]

From: Mike Sullivan <mike.sullivan@econify.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@econify.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: full subprocessor inventory + routing for US/EU

Aditya — appreciate the fast response and the plan. Econify will elect EU residency for the initial environment (we'll confirm the tenancy flag this week). The procurement team is fine with a redacted CSV as long as we get vendor country and role columns plus the onshore-fallback statement.

Next steps: if you can share the CSV and the diagram, we'll review and loop Legal for a DPA addendum. If your Legal team can pre-seed a DPA addendum (short bullet points, we can route on our side), that will speed approval. Otherwise procurement will mark this as a blocker.

Thanks again — target to receive by Sep 7 still works for us.

Mike Sullivan
Head of Security Operations
Econify
